newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals market shut for religious festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals market shut for religious festival.

text.p: The Indian metals market remained closed on Tuesday for the Jain festival holiday, dealers said.
It was also closed on Monday for the Ganesh festival. The markets reopen on Wednesday.
On the last trading day on Friday, copper prices eased with ready copper down 50 rupees at 11,900 rupees per quintal as world markets continued to fall, dealers said.
Tin and nickel also fell while lead was firm.
Dealers said overseas copper has fallen to a two-month low.
